summary.headline: Glykas’s Counter-Apology for Astrology
summary.text: Michael Glykas’s partial counter-apology to Emperor Manuel Komnenos defending astrology through natural and scriptural arguments. The opening discusses celestial bodies’ fixed natural activities, astrology’s mathematical interpretation, Christ’s gentleness, and a story about a Hebrew in the life of Saint Basil.
